summary: Drives the shared ripple array so any water shader reacts, without knowing which shader it is.
overview: Drop it on any object whose Renderer uses a shader including the ripple include — every water shader in the toolkit already does. It drives the shared impacts array through a MaterialPropertyBlock, so it never needs to know which specific water shader is on the surface.
useCases: Impact ripples where something enters the water.
Any surface shader that wants expanding rings.

params.tuning: Together with the array size this decides how many ripples can overlap before the oldest is replaced.
World units per second. Slow ripples on a large lake look right; the same value on a puddle looks frozen.

gotchas.title: The shader must include the ripple header
gotchas.body: On a material that does not, the emitter runs and nothing appears. That is the first thing to check.

gotchas.title: Impacts are a fixed-size array
gotchas.body: Beyond the limit, the oldest ripple is replaced. Rapid emission means short-lived ripples.
